notes.text: Module boards carry R_PROG (often 1.2 kΩ, about 1 A), the input/battery capacitors, the CHRG/STDBY LEDs and TEMP tied to GND; TEMP, PROG, CE and the status pins are not on the header. Check your board.
The DW01A + FS8205 pair disconnects the cell on over-discharge, overcharge or short circuit between OUT+ and OUT-; load the cell only through OUT+/OUT-, never from B-.
Set R_PROG for the cell: a 1 A module on a small LiPo charges it too fast.
